about.title: About Pixuvo
about.description: Pixuvo is a free browser game portal: games from licensed distribution partners, sorted so you can find your next favorite quickly.
about.html:
{tagline} Pixuvo collects free browser games in one place and sorts them so you can find something to play in a few seconds. {subline}

Where the games come from

We do not make the games. They are created by independent developers and distributed by game distribution partners (currently GameMonetize, GamePix and Playgama), who allow publishers like Pixuvo to embed them. The games run on the partners’ servers inside a frame on our pages. Advertising you see inside a game is served by the partner.

Right now the catalog contains {count} games. Categories, tags and player counts come from the information the partners provide; where something is unknown we leave it out rather than guess.

What Pixuvo does not do

  • No accounts, chat or payments. Favorites and history stay in your browser. More for families: For parents.
  • No game downloads or installers.
  • No advertising on Pixuvo pages. Google Analytics runs only if you allow it — see Privacy.

Artwork and fonts

The Pixu mascot and logo are our own. Category icons are Fluent Emoji by Microsoft (MIT license), interface icons are from Lucide (ISC license) and the headline font is Nunito (SIL Open Font License). Game names and images belong to their developers.

Who runs Pixuvo

Pixuvo is operated by {operatorName}, {address}, company ID (IČO) {companyId}. Contact: {email}.

parents.title: For Parents – Is Pixuvo Safe for Kids?
parents.description: How Pixuvo keeps game time simple and safe: no accounts, no chat, no ads on our pages, games checked before they appear, in-game purchases marked.
parents.html:
Pixuvo is a free collection of browser games for kids and families. Here is exactly what your child gets — and what they do not.

What Pixuvo does not have

  • No accounts and no chat. Kids cannot message strangers on Pixuvo and never type in a name, e-mail or password.
  • No ads on Pixuvo pages. Games come from distribution partners (GameMonetize, GamePix, Playgama), who may show short ads inside the game, for example before it starts.
  • No downloads or installers. Games run in the browser.

How games get onto Pixuvo

  • Every game comes from a licensed distribution partner. Titles and tags that mention adult content, gambling, betting or kissing are held back automatically and never published without review.
  • Games that name a third-party brand (for example a famous franchise) are held back until we can check them.
  • Anyone can report a game with the Report Issue button under it; we read every report.

Purchases inside games

Pixuvo itself sells nothing. Some partner games offer optional in-game purchases; when the partner declares this, the game page shows 💳 In-game purchases. Partners do not always say, so we recommend keeping purchase approval on in your browser or device settings.

Privacy

Favorites and recently played games stay in your child’s browser. Usage statistics (Google Analytics) run only if someone allows them in the privacy choices — you can use every feature without it. Details: Privacy and Cookies.

Questions or a problem?

Write to {email} — we answer every message.

cookies.title: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.description: Which browser storage Pixuvo uses, which is optional, and how to change your choice.
cookies.html:
Without your consent Pixuvo pages set no cookies. We use your browser’s local storage only for features you use:

KeyWhat it doesType
pixuvo:favoritesGames you marked with the heartNecessary for the feature you asked for
pixuvo:recentRecently played listNecessary for the feature
pixuvo:vote:<id>Remembers your like/dislikeNecessary for the feature
pixuvo:consentYour privacy choiceNecessary
pixuvo_lang (cookie, 1 year)Remembers the language you choseNecessary for the feature you asked for
pixuvo:src:<id> (session storage)Keeps the same game version during one visitNecessary
_ga, _ga_XESJS34X9Z (cookies, Google Analytics)Tell visits apart for usage statistics; up to 2 yearsOptional — only with your consent

Optional technologies

Analytics (Google Analytics 4) runs only after you allow it. Advertising features, Google signals and ad personalisation are switched off. We show no advertising on our pages. You can review or change your choice at any time — withdrawing consent stops analytics and deletes its cookies:

Inside games

A game is loaded from our partner when you open its game page (list pages load only cover images). Inside the game frame, the partner and its advertising providers may use cookies or similar technologies and may show their own consent message. Their policies apply; you can also block third-party cookies in your browser.

Spam protection

When you vote or report a problem, Cloudflare Turnstile may check your browser to tell humans from bots. It loads only at that moment.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What personal data Pixuvo processes, why, for how long, and your rights under the GDPR.
privacy.html:
Controller

{operatorName}, {address}, company ID (IČO) {companyId} (“we”). Contact for privacy matters: {email}.

What we process and why

DataPurposeLegal basis (GDPR)Retention
IP address and request data (browser, page requested) handled by our hosting provider CloudflareDelivering the website, security, abuse and rate limitingLegitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f)Short-lived provider logs; we do not store IP addresses in our database
A one-way hash derived from your IP address and a secret, when you vote or report a problemAllow one vote per visitor and stop spamLegitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f)Votes: while the game is listed. Reports: up to 12 months
The text of a problem report you sendFixing the problem you reportedLegitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f)Up to 12 months
E-mails you send usAnswering youLegitimate interest / steps at your requestAs long as needed for the conversation, at most 3 years
Usage statistics via Google Analytics 4 — pages viewed, games started, device and browser type, approximate country; set with the _ga cookiesUnderstanding which games and pages kids use, so we can improve the catalogConsent, Art. 6(1)(a) — only if you allow “Analytics”Data retention set in Google Analytics (we use the shortest standard period); cookies up to 2 years unless you withdraw consent
Daily totals of plays per game (no personal data)Ranking popular games, finding broken ones—Aggregated statistics

Favorites, recently played games, your votes and your privacy choice are stored only in your browser’s local storage. We never receive that list.

Google Analytics runs only after you allow “Analytics” in the privacy choices. It is provided by Google Ireland Limited (Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland) as our processor; data may be transferred to Google LLC in the USA under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. We switched off advertising features, Google signals and ad personalisation, and we send no names, e-mails or user IDs. You can withdraw consent at any time in the privacy choices; we then stop analytics and delete the _ga cookies. We show no advertising on Pixuvo pages.

Pixuvo is meant for children too. If you are under 15, please ask a parent before allowing optional analytics; you can use every feature without it.

Games from partners

When you open a game page, the game is loaded from our distribution partner (GameMonetize, GamePix or Playgama, named on each game page). From that moment the partner, and the advertising companies it works with, receive data such as your IP address and device information and may use cookies or similar technologies inside the game frame. They act as independent controllers under their own privacy policies, available on their websites. Pages that only list games (home, categories, search) load nothing from the game partners except cover images.

Processors and transfers

Cloudflare, Inc. hosts the website, database and spam protection (Turnstile). Cloudflare may process data outside the EU under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses.

Children

Pixuvo is a general-audience website and does not ask anyone for personal information. Some games may appeal to children; parents should review the games their children play. Games and in-game advertising are provided by partners, as described above.

Your rights

You can ask for access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and data portability by writing to {email}. Because we store only hashes, we may need details (game, date) to find a record. You may lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů, www.uoou.cz) or your local authority.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: The rules for using Pixuvo, a free browser game portal.
terms.html:
1. The service

Pixuvo ({siteUrl}) is operated by {operatorName}, {address}, company ID {companyId}. Pixuvo lists free browser games that are developed by third parties and provided through distribution partners. Using Pixuvo is free and requires no account.

2. Third-party games

Games run on partners’ servers and may contain advertising served by the partner. We select and describe games carefully but we do not control their content, availability or how they work, and we do not guarantee that any game will be available or work on your device. Saved progress, if a game offers it, is handled by the game itself, not by Pixuvo.

3. Acceptable use

Do not attempt to disrupt the service, scrape it at a rate that harms it, bypass its security, or submit unlawful, abusive or misleading reports or votes.

4. Intellectual property

Games, names and images belong to their respective owners. The Pixuvo name, logo and site design belong to the operator. See Copyright if you believe something infringes your rights.

5. Liability

Pixuvo is provided “as is”. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damage arising from third-party games or from temporary unavailability. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have as a consumer under mandatory law.

6. Changes and law

We may update these terms; the date above shows the latest version. These terms are governed by Czech law. Contact: {email}.

copyright.title: Copyright and Trademark Notices
copyright.description: How to tell Pixuvo about content that infringes your copyright or trademark.
copyright.html:
Pixuvo embeds games provided by distribution partners and does not host the game files. We respect intellectual property rights and act quickly on valid notices. Games that use third-party brands in their title are held for manual review before they appear on Pixuvo.

How to send a notice

E-mail {email} with:

  1. the Pixuvo URL(s) of the game or page concerned;
  2. a description of the work or trademark you believe is infringed;
  3. your name, contact details and your relationship to the rights holder;
  4. a statement that you believe in good faith the use is not authorised, and that the information in your notice is accurate.

You can also use Report issue → Copyright or trademark problem on any game page; for formal notices please use e-mail.

What happens next

We review notices promptly. When a notice is valid we remove or disable the game on Pixuvo and inform the distribution partner. Removing a game from Pixuvo does not remove it from the partner’s catalog or from other websites.
